projects.title: Secure Document Link Gateway
projects.problem: Provide time-limited access to documents retrieved from remote storage while keeping the download path separate from retrieval and housekeeping.
projects.architecture: A Java and Spring Boot gateway serves documents from a file cache. Links carry an encrypted reference and expiry. Background jobs retrieve documents and clean up expired entries, with PostgreSQL supporting the document lifecycle.
decisions: Use AES-GCM authenticated encryption so the gateway can check the link and its expiry without a per-download database lookup.
Separate document retrieval and cleanup from the request path so serving a document does not require fetching it from the source.
reliability: Keep cache availability consistent with link lifetimes across independent scheduled jobs.
Make a document available only after retrieval finishes and remove cached files when their links expire.

steps.detail: Retrieves source files and publishes completed files to the cache.

steps.title: Download gateway
steps.detail: Validates the encrypted link and streams the cached file.

projects.title: XML Transformation Pipeline
projects.problem: Exchange XML between systems that use different formats and let integration rules evolve without restarting the service.
projects.architecture: RabbitMQ receives XML requests. A router selects the destination and a Saxon XSLT stage transforms the payload before publishing to a downstream queue. Java functions provide extensions for stylesheets.
decisions: Load Java extensions through separate plugin classloaders to isolate their classes.
Reload the transformation context during redeployment so rule changes do not require a service restart.
reliability: Use a bounded worker pool to limit concurrent processing.
Give failed messages a separate handling path and support requeuing so failures are not silently discarded.

projects.title: Messenger Archive & Semantic Search
projects.problem: Make archived text and voice messages searchable by meaning and accessible through an MCP client.
projects.architecture: A Rust service syncs messages over MTProto into PostgreSQL. A Python worker transcribes audio with Whisper. A Rust indexer embeds the text and upserts vectors in Qdrant, and an MCP server exposes search to AI clients.
decisions: Use deterministic UUIDv5 vector IDs so reprocessing a message updates the same Qdrant point.
Advance the checkpoint only after the upsert succeeds so interrupted batches can be processed again.
reliability: Claim transcription jobs from PostgreSQL without blocking other workers that are handling different rows.
Handle failures across PostgreSQL, Qdrant and the checkpoint with idempotent writes and resumable indexing.
